author: DonaldMyTrump
body:
Hello Avicus Staff members, I am YouCantCMe/Zac. I received
"Hello.
I am unsure of why the administrators have told you that racism is not against the rules. 
Racism is most certainly against the rules on Avicus; it is a form of bullying, which is not allowed on the 18+ channel. You should understand this.
As for your insulting the staff, your last statement:
"29 views and 4 days later... Hi guys! It's zac, since no Sr staff member has made a decision, provided evidence or corrected me on my interpretation of the rules can I get appealed now?"
Please do not leave comments like these on appeals. Don't automatically assume that we haven't made a decision. Posting these types of things will ultimately lower your chances of a senior moderator checking your appeal.
Also, your previous appeal was denied. There was no point in creating this one.
This appeal is denied.
Regards,
MidnightBeats
Senior Moderator"
on my last appeal.
I just had something to point out; You are sure of what administrators told me because the infraction got appealed before para decided: screw it I will keep him banned if I want. Racism wasn't against the rules in 18+ and I was told so by both administrators, if the senior mods and administrators are debating rules amongst each other and I received false information this is not my fault. Also If you read my first appeal ( https://avicus.net/forums/67b4012ad ) I define bullying and point out why what I did can't be considered bullying. Lastly if you have made a decision which you claim I assume you didn't why wouldn't you post it. It's just a waste of time to make a decision and not post it, and therefore it makes no sense. Please stop locking these posts so I don't have to keep making more just to respond to you since, most senior mods are refusing to add me on skype so we can talk there.

Regards,

Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
